_description: CHEETAH v5.2 — Multi-signal confluence sniper (over-trading fix). v5.1 shipped with 80% margin + 5% max_loss + 25-min dead_weight_cut, produced 406 fills / -28% ROI / ~$1,600 in fees. v5.2 pulls every knob toward Kodiak-family discipline: marginPct 80%→30%, MIN_SCORE 10→11, DSL loosened across every dimension. Same signal architecture, just no longer self-destructive sizing.
_thesis: Asymmetric Arena ROE is achievable with 30% margin when signal quality is actually high. 80% margin was concentration-gambling, not sniping. v5.2 preserves the confluence thesis with survivable sizing.
